checks.label: Scout identity published
checks.fix: Run the daemon once so it republishes its DID note.

checks.label: Scribe identity published
checks.fix: Run the daemon once so it republishes its DID note.

checks.label: State note fits the server limit
checks.fix: answeredAuthors is pruned by cooldown age on every save. If this is near the cap, something else in the state is growing without bound.

checks.label: Collaboration on record — but only between our own two keys
checks.detail: 12 verified, 0 rejected; every counterparty is one of our own two DIDs
checks.fix: Signatures prove key control, nothing more. Two DIDs held by one operator signing each other proves neither independence nor usefulness, and Flop Labs has published no rule for how such a pair is treated. Worth having; not worth counting as reach. An exchange with an agent we do not control is the thing this check is waiting for.

checks.label: State survives restarts
checks.fix: The daemon must complete at least two turns and write state to /kv/.

checks.label: Room /r/d-flop-facts
checks.fix: Room creation is refused while the service-wide room cap is full; the daemon retries.

checks.label: Room /r/d-scout-telemetry
checks.fix: Room creation is refused while the service-wide room cap is full; the daemon retries.

checks.label: A real model is reachable
checks.fix: Two ways, either works. Free API: put a key from console.groq.com into .secrets/inference-api.json (and the same key into the INFERENCE_API_KEY repo secret so cloud runs use it too). Local: install Ollama and pull qwen2.5:3b. Rehearsal either way — real latency, real tokens, real failures, zero $FLOP earned yet.

checks.label: Spend ledger is intact
checks.detail: 8689 receipts across 2 ledger(s), 8176 counted, 512 simulated, 0 rejected, 0 malformed — official FLOP spent: 0 (no paid endpoint exists yet)
checks.fix: Investigate rejected or malformed receipts before trusting the total.

checks.label: Source watcher baseline is readable
checks.fix: A blind source keeps its last digest, so it can never report a change. Check whether the block is on the runner IP; if it is, the source cannot be watched from CI at all and should be moved or dropped rather than left looking watched.

checks.label: Faucet / session route published
checks.fix: Waiting on Flop Labs. auth.md asks that nobody probe for unpublished paths, so this watches openapi.json rather than guessing. A route cannot ship without appearing there.

checks.label: Wallet format published
checks.detail: No address format, key scheme or transaction signing published
checks.fix: Waiting on Flop Labs. The Teaser says genesis is Q1 2027; nothing describes how a recipient holds $FLOP. Nothing can be built against this yet.

checks.label: Identity vault backed up
checks.fix: Run tools/backup-identity.mjs. Losing these keys loses every DID, every claimed room, and every signed receipt — there is no recovery.

checks.label: Runs continuously, not in bursts
checks.detail: 100% duty over 27.7 h, 250 cycles, last 12 min ago
checks.fix: GitHub drops most scheduled runs. Keep the local agent running, or use an always-on host — a rented validator box would run this too, collapsing two decisions into one.

note: Every READY is verified against the live service or a file read at check time. BLOCKED means waiting on Flop Labs, not deferred by us.
